title: Mecha Spider Invasion
description: A colossal multi-legged mechanical spider with glowing orange eyes rampages through a dark cyberpunk city street at night. Red and pink viscous liquid drips from a torn sky, pooling on the ground as panicked human figures flee between towering buildings and elevated trains.
prompt: A massive biomechanical spider robot with glowing orange eyes and multiple articulated metal legs rampaging through a rainy cyberpunk city street at night, towering brutalist buildings in the background, panicked humans running away, a torn apocalyptic sky dripping thick red and pink viscous liquid that splashes onto the wet streets, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
